description: This Java class provides a backward-compatible utility wrapper for android.widget.OverScroller, allowing developers to obtain current velocity information in a way that works across different Android API levels.

classes.name: OverScrollerCompat
classes.description: A utility class for using OverScroller in a backward-compatible way, primarily providing a method to get the current velocity.

methods.name: getCurrVelocity
methods.description: Returns the current velocity of the provided OverScroller instance if the API level supports it; otherwise, returns 0.
